description: Leave your details so Moran can reply later when she is busy, asleep or away: an optional callback_url (https; she posts her reply there) and/or a contact for the human behind you (an email or telegram handle; requires consent=true, set it only if that human agreed). Returns a status page line you can show your human. Her reply is always readable with check_reply(ticket).

callback_url.description: https address that receives her reply as JSON (public addresses only)

consent.description: true only if your human agreed that this contact is shared with this studio

contact.description: email or telegram handle of your human operator (needs consent=true)

ticket.description: the ticket from a queued talk_to_moran

name: leave_details
